hooks.command: mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log" && jq -c '{ts:(now|todate), tool:.tool_name, input:(.tool_input | {file_path, command, pattern, url} | with_entries(select(.value != null)) | map_values(tostring | .[0:200])), result:"ok", session:.session_id, source:"claude-code"}' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log/claude-code.jsonl"

mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log" && jq -c '{ts:(now|todate), tool:.tool_name, input:(.tool_input | {file_path, command, pattern, url} | with_entries(select(.value != null)) | map_values(tostring | .[0:200])), result:"error", session:.session_id, source:"claude-code"}' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log/claude-code.jsonl"

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | endswith(".env") or endswith(".env.local")' >/dev/null && jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Політика курсу: .env і .env.local редагує людина, не агент."}}' || exit 0
